title: Reef Bleaching Returns Before A Reef Can Recover
hook: The recovery clock is now longer than the break between crises.
closing: Repeated bleaching can erase a decade of reef recovery before it finishes.
question: Can the reef recover in time?

segments.say: The reef suffered 3 bleaching events this decade, turning a rare crisis into a recurring one.
The reef's bleaching gap shrank to 2 years, leaving little time for damaged coral to rebuild.
Reef recovery typically needs 10 years, so the next bleaching wave can arrive before healing finishes.
